name: backlight
title: Backlight
description: Wraps content in a blurred, colour-boosted copy of itself, so a colourful card throws a soft backlight halo. In this demo the blur deepens on hover.
use: A colourful card or image should feel lit from within and lift off a dark page.
avoid: Light backgrounds, where the halo washes out, and content that needs crisp hard edges.
a11y: The effect is decorative and hidden from assistive tech, but the hover transition ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A thin-bordered dark card on black carries a large purple-to-pink gradient word and two lines of small grey text. Its own colours leak outward as a wide, soft halo of blue and magenta past every edge.
behaves: The halo is a blurred, saturation-boosted copy of the card sitting behind it, so it follows any colour inside. Hovering the demo card increases the blur and pushes the glow further out, easing back when the pointer leaves.
customise: Wrap any element as children and set the blur radius; the colour boost is fixed at four times saturation, and the glow colours come from the content itself.
weight: moderate: A full-card blur and colour filter is recomputed whenever the blur radius changes.
